book.name: 1 K'oronttoosa
book.title: P'awuloosi K'oronttoosa Asaw S'aafeedda Koyro Kiitaa

content: Geeshsha Ayaanaa Imotaanne Unttunttu Maaduwaa
Siik'uwaa kaallite. Ayaanaa imotaakka loytsi koyyite. Shin ubbaappe aatsiide, nabetetsaa koyyite.

Ayaw gooppe, dumma dumma k'aalaan haasayiyaa uray S'oossaw haasayeeppe attin, asaw haasayenna. Ayaw gooppe, I haasayiyaawaa ooninne akeekena. Shin asaw k'onc'c'ibeenna yewuwaa Ayaanaa wolk'k'aan haasayee.
Shin nabii asaa maaddanaw, zoranawunne minisanaw asaw haasayee.
Dumma dumma k'aalaan haasayiyaa uray barena maaddee. Shin nabii woosa golliyaa maaddee.

Hinttenttu ubbay dumma dumma k'aalaan hasayaanawaa taani dosay. Shin nabetetsaa hewaappe aatsaade dosay. Ayaw gooppe, dumma dumma k'aalaan haasayiyaawe he haasayeeddawaa woosa golliyaa maaddanaw billiyaa Asay d'ayooppe, dumma dumma k'aalaan haasayiyaawaappe nabetetsay aad'd'ee.

Shin taanaadan ammaniyaawanttoo, ha"i taani hinttenttukko baade, dumma dumma k'aalaan haasayaadde, sas'aan woy eratetsaan woy nabetetsaan woy tamaarissiyaawaan hinttenttoo odana d'ayooppe, taani hinttentta ayaa maaddaytaa?
Haray atto, shemppuu baynnabay suusulliyaa gidina woy diitsaa gidina kaa'iidde, bare kaassaa dummatetsaa erissana d'ayooppe, suusulliyaa punnooppenne, woy diitsaa diis's'ooppe, Asay wootiide eranee?
K'ay s'urumbbaa waasuu loytsi erettana d'ayooppe, olaw oonee giigettanawee?
Hawaadankka, k'ay dumma dumma k'aalaan hintte haasaayiyaawe k'onc'c'e gidennaan d'ayooppe, hintte haasayiyaawaa Asay wooti akeekanee? Ayaw gooppe, c'arkkoo hintte haasayiita.
Ha alamiyaan c'ora k'aalay de'ee; shin biletsay baynna k'aalay ittuunne baawa.
Shin itti Asay haasayiyaa k'aalaa taani erana d'ayooppe, he haasayiyaawe taw imatsaa gidee; taanikka aw imatsaa giday.
Hawaadankka, k'ay Geeshsha Ayaanaa imotaa hintte akkanaw loytsi koyyiyaawantta gidiyaa diraw, woosa golliyaa dichchanaw maaddawaa ubbabaappe aatsiide koyyite.
Hewaa diraw, dumma dumma k'aalaan haasayiyaawe bare haasayeeddawaa billanaw danddayana mala, S'oossaa woosso.
Ayaw gooppe, taani dumma dumma k'aalaan S'oossaa woossooppe, ta ayyaanaykka woossee; shin ta garssa k'ofay ayinne go"ettenna.
Yaatina, taani wootoo? Taani ta ayyaanan S'oossaa woosana; k'ay ta k'ofankka S'oossaa woosana. Ta ayyaanan yes's'ana; k'ay ta k'ofankka yes's'ana.

Hewaa gidana d'ayooppe, neeni ne ayaanaa s'alalaan S'oossaa galatiyaawaa gidooppe, he sa'aan neeni giyaawaa erenna Asay neeni S'oossaa galatiyaawaa erennaan, neeni galateeddawaan wootiide, «Amen"i» gaanee?
Neeni S'oossaa galatiyaawe lo"a; shin hewe yekko bitaniyaa maaddenna.
Taani dumma dumma k'aalaan hintte ubbaappe aatsaade haasayiyaa diraw, S'oossaa galatay.
Shin taani woosa gollen haratuwaa tamaarissanaw dumma dumma k'aalaan tammu sha"a k'aalatuwaa haasayiyaawaappe ichcheshu k'aalatuwaa ta wozanaa k'ofaan haasayanaw dosay.
Taanaadan ammaniyaawanttoo, hintte iita yewuwaan guutsa naanaa mala gidanaappe attin, k'ofaan guutsa naanaa mala gidoppite; hintte garssa k'ofaan wozanaamatuwaa gidite.
S'oossaa Mas'aafan,
geetettiide s'aafetteedda.

Simmi dumma dumma k'aalaan haasaayiyaawe ammanennawanttoo malaataa gidiyaawaappe attin, ammaniyaawanttoo malaataa gidenna. K'ay nabatuwaappe haasayettiyaawe ammaniyaawanttoo malaataa gidiyaawaappe attin, ammanennawanttoo malaataa gidenna.
Hewaa diraw, ammaniyaa Asay ubbay ittippe shiik'iide, k'ay ubbaykka dumma dumma k'aalaan haasayooppe, tamaaribeenna Asay woy ammanenna Asay geliide, hinttentta ubbaa, «Gooyiita» geennee?
Shin tamaaribeenna Asay woy ammanenna Asay woosa golle geliyaa wode, Asay ubbay timbbitiyaa odooppe, I bare sisiyaawaan bare nagaraa akeekee. K'ay he siseeddabaa ubbankka I pirddettana.
Aa wozanaan geemmeedda k'ofaykka k'onc'c'ana. Hawaadankka k'ay, «S'oossay tumu hintte giddon de'ee» yaagiide markkattiidde, guufanniide S'oossaw goyinnana.
Asay Ittippe Woossiyaa Wode De'anaw Bessiyaa Wogaa

Simmi taanaadan ammaniyaawanttoo, ayee? Hinttenttu ittippe shiik'iyaa wode, huup'iyaan huup'iyaan, ittoo mazimurii de'ee; ittoo tamaarissiyaawe de'ee; ittoo sas'ay de'ee; k'ay ittoo dumma dumma k'aalaan haasaayiyaawe de'ee; ittoo billiyaawe de'ee. Ubbaykka woosa golliyaa maaddiyaawaa gidanaw bessee.
Ooninne dumma dumma k'aalaan haasayooppe, laa"u gidiide, woy darooppe heezzu gidiide, kaallaan kaallaan haasayanaw bessee. K'ay hara ittuu unttunttu haasayeeddawaa billo.
Shin billiyaa Asay d'ayooppe, dumma dumma k'aalaan haasayiyaawe woosa golliyaan c'o"u go. Bare huup'ewunne S'oossaw haasayo.
Nabatuukka laa"u gidiide woy heezzu gidiide haasayino. K'ay haranttu unttunttu giyaawaa shaakkino.
Shin S'oossay he sa'aan utteedda haraw ittibaa k'onc'c'issooppe, kasenna haasayiyaawe c'o"u go.
Ayaw gooppe, ubbay tamaarana malanne ubbay minnana mala, kaallaan kaallaan timbbitiyaa odanaw danddayiita.
Timbbitiyaa odiyaawanttu imotay unttunttoo azazettee.
Ayaw gooppe, S'oossay sarotetsaa S'oossaappe attin, c'abbuwaa S'oossaa gidenna. Geeshshatuu woosa golletuwaa ubbaan,
mac'c'awanttu shiik'uwaa garssan c'o"u giino. Ayaw gooppe, Ayihudatuwaa higgii giyaawaadankka unttunttu moodettanaappe attin, shiik'uwaa garssan haasayanaw unttunttoo maati baawa.
Mac'c'awanttu shiik'uwaa garssan haasaayiyaawe pokko gidiyaa diraw, ayentto eranaw koyyooppenne soyin barenttu asinaa oochchino.
S'oossaa k'aalay koyro hintteppe yeeddee? Woy hintte s'alalaakko yeeddee?
Ooninne barena nabiyaa woy S'oossaa Ayyaanay de'iyaa asaa yaagiide k'oppooppe, taani hinttenttoo s'aafiyaawe Godaa azazuwaa gidiyaawaa akeeko.
Shin ooninne akeekana d'ayooppe, akeekoppo bashi aggo.
Hewaa diraw, taanaadan ammaniyaawanttoo, timbbitiyaa odanaw loytsi amottite. K'ay dumma dumma k'aalaan haasayiyaawaakka diggoppite.
Shin ubbabaykka wogaaninne maaran hano.
